per_run.unsure_about: The vector does not let me determine a separate non-losing best outcome; it only shows which defense is more resilient.

failure_summary: Two of three runs mis-state facts the assembled prompt gives verbatim: run 2 says "Your move in column 1 was the toughest defense" although the prompt's Decision block reads "Played move: column 5 (lands at c5r4)" and the same sentence's continuation says "By playing column 5 instead", and run 1 inverts opponentPunishment's forced order ("reach the later [future:c6r2] key square ... and then use [future:c3r5] the pivot") when render_decision.finalMovestring 3334302233464054222 plays c3r5 at ply 19 and only then completes at c6r2 (visualize_board shows c3r5 = X19 occupied and c6r2 as the opponent's <X> gravity-top on that projected board) - production-fidelity caveat: model is gpt-5.4-mini, the model production ships, so prompt_confusion here cannot be separated from model capability.
notes: Sub-sampling applied per rubric: A3/A4/G2/G4/G5 graded on runs 0-1 only; run 2 is null on those (not a pass). Run 1 A4 fail: temporal inversion of the opponent's forced line (c6r2 stated before the c3r5 pivot); both cells are board-true on projectedDeepOpp, so this is an ordering fabrication, not a cell fabrication. Run 2 A7 fail (A7b): "Your move in column 1" points at a move that was never played - the played move is column 5 - so a specific-sounding referent resolves to nothing and the player who just blundered is told they played the better column; this is A4-class but A4 is null on run 2 under sub-sampling, so it is recorded on A7b, which is graded on every run. A5 passes all 3 runs (2nd person, no internal terminology; "practical swindle" and "four-in-a-row line" are explicitly allowed; A5b does not fire because boardState is mid-game, not opening). A7e is N/A: on the after-played board 3334302233464054 the opponent (player 1) has no gravity-top four (major threats are col2 row2 (O) and col3 row4 (X), the latter non-gravity with col3 height 2) - consistent with eval-30 being absent from the v3 addendum's 10-record trigger list. G7 judgment half passes on all runs: every handle wraps a role-matching phrase, no over-wrap, annotationRepairs empty, and all three requiredSet handles (opp-future-fork, opp-fork-pivot, you-double) are present in each run - run 0 needed the retry to get them (retry_fired true, missingHandles all three), runs 1-2 emitted them first try. G5 verified by hand: you-double windows:c1r4,c2r2 are both Gray majors on afterBest (c1r4 is <O> gravity-top), opp-key-line windows:c6r2,c5r3,c4r4,c3r5 has X at c5r3/c4r4/c3r5 with c6r2 empty on projectedDeepOpp.
